Keep the tray icon visible beside the clock. Amber means a choice is pending; gray means waiting, snoozed or dismissed; blue means dark mode.
Left-click the tray icon to open Settings; right-click for theme, snooze and reminder actions. Ctrl + Alt + Shift + D also switches themes. Themes never change automatically, including in the morning.
Settings save automatically. Switches and language apply immediately. Press Enter or leave the time section to apply both times together; minutes apply on Enter or leaving the field, and +/− applies immediately. Closing tries to apply valid drafts, keeps earlier values for invalid drafts and does not undo saved changes. Follow Windows uses the display language at startup, with English as fallback. Incomplete or invalid input does not prevent closing. If a valid time or minute draft cannot be written, Settings stays open with an inline error for retry, without a dialog.
NightCue runs locally, without network requests. Settings and state stay beside the executable. Before uninstalling, turn off sign-in startup, wait for confirmation and exit from the tray menu. After moving the app, use Repair startup path if an old location is registered. If a startup change fails, feedback is shown and registration is read again. If it cannot be read, startup controls are disabled and the status is unknown.
Open the hidden-icons arrow beside the clock and drag NightCue onto the taskbar. You can also enable NightCue in Windows taskbar settings (Windows 11: other system tray icons; Windows 10: select which icons appear on the taskbar). Windows controls icon visibility; NightCue cannot pin itself. A gold sun offers light mode after the end time. It never switches themes automatically.
